claim: The Copper runs at 28 MHz on core 3.0 (14 MHz on core 2.0); a MOVE takes 2 Copper clocks and a WAIT 1, and the register holds the new value 2 clocks after the MOVE.
limit: Documentation only: the wiki says the precise core 3.0 timing is not documented yet, and it does not say how a WAIT compares; measure before relying on a per-pixel position.

evidence.text: Copper page, read 2026-11-23: executed at 28 MHz on core 3.0 and 14 MHz on core 2.0; WAIT duration 1 clock, MOVE duration 2 clocks.
evidence.quote: (core 3.0) the copper code is executed at 28MHz, the precise timing is not documented yet
